title: com.cuvara.vfx capture statistics (stats.json)
description: stats.json written by the capture verb next to contact-sheet.png and one PNG per sample. The final result of the verb holds the same fields plus the envelope (ok, verb, errors, warnings) and out, stats_file, probes, pending, job. Counts come from VisualEffect.aliveParticleCount read while the effect is held still, so they are never -1. Documentation~/CAPTURE.md.

effect.description: project path of the captured .prefab or .vfx (Assets/... or Packages/com.cuvara.vfx/...)

recipe_sha256.description: SHA-256 of the <name>.vfxrecipe.json next to the effect's .vfx, or null when there is none

duration_seconds.description: simulated time of the first probe after the peak with no particle alive and no system awake; null when the effect did not end by max_seconds or never had a particle

peak.description: largest alive count at any sample or probe

bounds.description: world-space union of the bounds of every particle system at the checkpoints where it had particles; null when no particle was alive

name.description: particle system name; prefixed with the VisualEffect's path in the prefab when the effect has several

mean_luminance.description: Rec. 709 luminance of the linear render target after post-processing (tonemapped), mean over the frame

resolution.description: frame width and height in pixels

settle_frames.description: frames the effect is held still before a count is read

characters.description: added 2026-11-27, optional: the characters the capture placed (inputs character, target_count, target_spacing, source_socket, target_socket); null when the capture placed none

character.description: the character input: placeholder, or the project path of the requested prefab

placed.description: what was placed: placeholder (the code-built VfxMannequin), or the project path of the prefab; placeholder when the requested prefab does not exist

binders.description: added 2026-11-27, optional: one entry per ChainLightningBinder the capture bound to the characters (empty when none); source and targets are the values the graph holds after binding, null or shorter when the graph does not expose the property

name.description: hierarchy path of the binder's object in the effect

added.description: true when the capture added the binder to a .vfx effect whose graph exposes the binder's default properties

graph_hop_count.description: the hop count property read back from the graph, or null when not exposed

position.description: world position of the character's root (its feet)

socket.description: world position of the bound socket (source_socket for the caster, target_socket for a target), or of the root when socket_found is false

in_frame.description: true when the world bounds of the character's renderers lie inside the camera's frame
